alignments.note: Comparative כְּ rendered by the single expression *As through* (rule 30's one-rendering reading), headed on the word carrying the comparison.
Noun with the indefinite article English licenses (rule 15); discontinuous around the adjective (rule 25).
Finite verb with its subject pronoun (rule 17).
תַּחַת recast as the fixed phrase *In the midst of*; head on the content word the phrase turns on (rule 24).
Hithpael with its subject pronoun and the reflexive its own voice licenses (rules 17 and 44).
The italic *upon me* supplies both a preposition and a pronoun the Hebrew never writes (rules 30 and 44).

review_notes: *As through* is kept whole on כְּ as one rendering rather than leaving *through* `added`; the margin's *Or, As a wide breaking in of waters* was read and set aside (rule 38).
